system.description: The spell is woven over a designated object within range, which is then imbued with vitner that enhances its properties. The vitner is woven together as a beneficial energy surrounding the object. The enhancing energy grants any person a positive modifier of +2 to all Skill Values and Situation values whenever the object is used. The enchantment also increases the damage of weapons by +1, the Protection Value of armor or weapons by +1, and the Breach Value by +10.
